title: Gronin playbook retrieve block
description: The value that replaces the reserved `retrieve` property of specs/001-runtime-core/contracts/playbook.schema.json when this feature lands; until then that schema refuses the block outright. Shape only, like the playbook schema: whether a collection is declared, whether query_from names a gather step, and whether an `as` collides are the runtime's refusals, not this schema's. A mode, an endpoint, a model, a credential or a provider is refused as an unknown key: they belong to the deployment's collection, never to a playbook.

collection.description: A collection the deployment's catalogue declares.

query.description: Interpolated like every other playbook string, against ${trigger.x} and ${config.x}. Searched as plain text: no word or character in it is search syntax.

query_from.description: The `as` of a gather step whose output is the query.

as.description: The file the results are written to in the run's working directory, where the agent reads them as it reads gathered input.

max_bytes.description: Every byte of the results file, the lines naming each result's source included.
